frame_account_level.granularity: ACCOUNT-LEVEL — same across every move (gap: not per-move yet)

frame_permove.granularity: move-level (per-move frame reader; veers measured vs account baseline)

moves.label: M1
moves.paraphrase: Mary Magdalene travels to the burial site in the pre-dawn dark of the week's first day.
moves.outcome: arrival at the tomb
moves.sitz: post-crucifixion mourning visit to a burial place, at first light
moves.narrator: the evangelist, third-person, as informed reporter

moves.label: M2
moves.paraphrase: She perceives that the sealing stone is no longer in place.
moves.substrate: the state of the stone being removed from the tomb
moves.outcome: visual registration of the tomb's disturbed state
moves.sitz: pre-dawn approach to a sealed rock-tomb

moves.label: M3
moves.paraphrase: She hurries back and reaches Simon Peter and the disciple Jesus loved.
moves.substrate: Simon Peter and the other disciple whom Jesus loved (as destination)
moves.outcome: arrival at the two disciples
moves.sitz: urgent report-carrying to fellow followers

moves.label: M4
moves.paraphrase: She reports to them what she has just seen.
moves.substrate: the embedded claim about the Lord's removal (M5)
moves.outcome: the two disciples now hold her testimony
moves.sitz: eyewitness delivering a first-report to companions

moves.label: M5
moves.paraphrase: Unnamed parties have removed the Lord's body from the burial place.
moves.substrate: the Lord (his body) in the tomb
moves.outcome: the Lord's body is no longer in the tomb
moves.sitz: a mourner's inference from a disturbed grave
moves.narrator: Mary Magdalene, within her reported speech, as inference from what she saw

moves.label: M6
moves.paraphrase: The speaker and her companions lack knowledge of where the body has been placed.
moves.substrate: the location where the Lord's body has been laid
moves.outcome: an admitted gap in knowledge
moves.sitz: a mourner unable to complete burial-tending
moves.narrator: Mary Magdalene, within her reported speech

moves.label: M7
moves.paraphrase: Peter and the other disciple set out and head toward the burial place.
moves.substrate: their prior location, with the tomb as destination
moves.outcome: they are on their way to the tomb
moves.sitz: disciples responding to an alarming report

moves.label: M8
moves.paraphrase: The two run side by side along the way.
moves.outcome: joint rapid movement toward the tomb
moves.sitz: urgency to verify a disturbing report

moves.label: M9
moves.paraphrase: The other disciple pulls ahead of Peter.
moves.outcome: the other disciple ahead of Peter
moves.sitz: two runners racing to a grave

moves.label: M10
moves.paraphrase: The other disciple reaches the burial place before Peter does.
moves.outcome: the other disciple present at the tomb before Peter
moves.sitz: first witness reaching the disturbed grave

moves.label: M11
moves.paraphrase: He bends down and looks inside the burial chamber.
moves.outcome: a threshold view into the tomb without entry
moves.sitz: a low-mouthed rock-tomb requiring stooping to see in

moves.label: M12
moves.paraphrase: He notices the burial wrappings lying inside.
moves.substrate: the linen cloths lying in the tomb
moves.outcome: visual registration of the abandoned wrappings
moves.sitz: first inspection of a disturbed grave's interior

moves.label: M13
moves.paraphrase: He refrains from crossing into the burial chamber.
moves.substrate: the interior of the tomb (as threshold not crossed)
moves.outcome: he remains outside
moves.sitz: hesitation before a corpse-defiling space

moves.label: M14
moves.paraphrase: Peter arrives behind him at the burial place.
moves.substrate: the path behind the other disciple, ending at the tomb
moves.outcome: Peter present at the tomb
moves.sitz: the slower runner catching up

moves.label: M15
moves.paraphrase: Peter crosses the threshold into the burial chamber.
moves.outcome: Peter inside the tomb
moves.sitz: the first entry into a disturbed grave

moves.label: M16
moves.paraphrase: From inside, Peter notices the burial wrappings lying there.
moves.substrate: the linen cloths lying in the tomb
moves.outcome: Peter's visual registration of the wrappings from within
moves.sitz: an interior inspection of a disturbed grave

moves.label: M17
moves.paraphrase: Peter also notes the head-covering set apart from the other wrappings, wrapped up in its own spot.
moves.substrate: the head-cloth, folded up and lying separately from the other linens
moves.outcome: registration of the distinct arrangement of the head-cloth
moves.sitz: careful inspection of a disturbed burial

moves.label: M18
moves.paraphrase: The disciple who had arrived first now also crosses into the burial chamber.
moves.outcome: the other disciple inside the tomb
moves.sitz: the first-arriver overcoming his earlier hesitation

moves.label: M19
moves.paraphrase: Inside, he takes in what is there.
moves.outcome: perception of the tomb's interior
moves.sitz: an interior look at the disturbed grave

moves.label: M20
moves.paraphrase: He comes to trust what he has seen.
moves.outcome: a state of belief
moves.sitz: a follower's response to seeing the emptied grave

moves.label: M21
moves.paraphrase: The narrator notes that the disciples had not yet grasped the scriptural claim about his rising.
moves.substrate: the Scripture (specifically, the embedded claim M22)
moves.outcome: an ignorance-state at this moment in the story
moves.sitz: a later teller looking back on the disciples' pre-understanding
moves.narrator: the evangelist, third-person, as retrospective aside

moves.label: M22
moves.paraphrase: According to Scripture, his rising from among the dead is a necessity.
moves.substrate: the condition of being among the dead
moves.outcome: rising out of the dead
moves.sitz: scriptural necessity as understood by the later community
moves.narrator: Scripture, as reported by the evangelist

moves.label: M23
moves.paraphrase: The two disciples leave and head back to where they are staying.
moves.substrate: the tomb (as origin), their own dwellings (as destination)
moves.outcome: the disciples departed from the tomb toward home
moves.sitz: witnesses withdrawing after inspection

moves.label: M24
moves.paraphrase: Mary remains at the burial place, positioned just outside it.
moves.outcome: Mary's continued presence at the tomb
moves.sitz: a mourner who cannot leave the grave

moves.label: M25
moves.paraphrase: She weeps while she stands there.
moves.outcome: an ongoing weeping
moves.sitz: a mourner grieving at a disturbed grave

moves.label: M26
moves.paraphrase: Still weeping, she bends down and looks into the burial chamber.
moves.outcome: a threshold view into the tomb
moves.sitz: a mourner finally looking inside a low-mouthed rock-tomb

moves.label: M27
moves.paraphrase: She sees two white-clad angels seated where the body had been, one where the head had lain and one where the feet had lain.
moves.substrate: two angels in white sitting at the head-position and foot-position of where Jesus' body had lain
moves.outcome: visual encounter with the two angels
moves.sitz: a mourner seeing heavenly figures inside a grave

moves.label: M28
moves.paraphrase: The angels address her and ask why she is weeping.
moves.outcome: Mary is addressed with a question
moves.sitz: heavenly figures engaging a mourner

moves.label: M29
moves.paraphrase: The angels ask her the reason for her weeping.
moves.outcome: a request for the cause of her lament
moves.sitz: heavenly interlocutors probing a mourner's grief
moves.narrator: the two angels, within reported speech

moves.label: M30
moves.paraphrase: Mary replies to them.
moves.outcome: the angels receive her explanation
moves.sitz: a mourner answering heavenly figures

moves.label: M31
moves.paraphrase: Unnamed parties have removed her Lord from the burial place.
moves.outcome: her Lord is no longer where he was laid
moves.sitz: a mourner's inference from a disturbed grave

moves.label: M32
moves.paraphrase: She herself does not know where they have placed him.
moves.substrate: the location where they have laid him
moves.outcome: an admitted gap in her knowledge
moves.sitz: a mourner unable to locate the missing body

moves.label: M33
moves.paraphrase: Having spoken, she turns her body around.
moves.outcome: Mary now facing the other direction
moves.sitz: a mourner shifting her gaze from the tomb

moves.label: M34
moves.paraphrase: She notices a man standing there.
moves.outcome: visual perception of a standing figure
moves.sitz: a mourner meeting an unrecognized figure at the grave
moves.narrator: the evangelist, third-person (knowing more than the character)

moves.label: M35
moves.paraphrase: She fails to recognize who the man is.
moves.outcome: a state of misrecognition
moves.sitz: a mourner failing to identify the risen one

moves.label: M36
moves.paraphrase: The figure she is seeing is in fact Jesus.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: the teller's superior knowledge about the risen one
moves.narrator: the evangelist (as narrator-knowledge disclosed inside Mary's non-knowledge)

moves.label: M37
moves.paraphrase: Jesus addresses her with two questions.
moves.outcome: Mary is addressed
moves.sitz: the risen one initiating dialogue

moves.label: M38
moves.paraphrase: He asks her why she is weeping.
moves.outcome: a request for the cause of her lament
moves.sitz: the risen one probing a mourner's grief

moves.label: M39
moves.paraphrase: He asks her whom she is looking for.
moves.outcome: a request to name whom she seeks
moves.sitz: the risen one probing what a mourner wants

moves.label: M40
moves.paraphrase: She takes the man before her to be the gardener.
moves.outcome: a mistaken cognition-state about who he is
moves.sitz: a mourner defaulting to the most plausible identity in a garden-tomb

moves.label: M41
moves.paraphrase: The figure is, in her supposition, the caretaker of the garden.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: a plausible identity in a tomb-garden
moves.narrator: Mary's supposition, reported by the evangelist

moves.label: M42
moves.paraphrase: She addresses him and asks him — on the condition that he took the body — to disclose where it is, so she can retrieve it.
moves.substrate: the embedded request (M43) and its accompanying promise (M44)
moves.outcome: the supposed gardener is petitioned
moves.sitz: a mourner petitioning a supposed caretaker

moves.label: M43
moves.paraphrase: She asks him — if he was the one who moved the body — to disclose to her where he placed it.
moves.substrate: the location where he laid the body
moves.outcome: disclosure of the body's location to Mary
moves.sitz: a petition conditional on the addressee having done the moving

moves.label: M44
moves.paraphrase: She promises that she herself will remove the body.
moves.outcome: the body relocated by Mary
moves.sitz: a mourner offering to complete burial-tending herself

moves.label: M45
moves.paraphrase: Jesus calls her by name.
moves.outcome: Mary is summoned by name
moves.sitz: the risen one naming his own by name

moves.label: M46
moves.paraphrase: She turns toward him.
moves.outcome: Mary now oriented toward Jesus
moves.sitz: recognition prompting a bodily reorientation

moves.label: M47
moves.paraphrase: She responds by addressing him as her teacher, in Aramaic.
moves.substrate: Jesus (addressed with the Aramaic term for 'teacher')
moves.outcome: Jesus is named as teacher
moves.sitz: a disciple recognizing her teacher

moves.label: M48
moves.paraphrase: The narrator glosses the Aramaic term she used with its equivalent for the audience.
moves.substrate: the Aramaic term Mary used in M47
moves.outcome: the term rendered accessible to a non-Aramaic audience
moves.sitz: a teller addressing an audience for whom Aramaic is not native
moves.narrator: the evangelist, third-person, as translator for the audience

moves.label: M49
moves.paraphrase: Jesus speaks to her with a series of instructions and an announcement.
moves.substrate: the embedded prohibition, commission, and announcement (M50, M52, M53)
moves.outcome: Mary receives his speech
moves.sitz: the risen one commissioning his witness

moves.label: M50
moves.paraphrase: He forbids her to cling to him, giving as his reason that he has not yet gone up to the Father.
moves.outcome: Mary refraining from holding him
moves.sitz: a risen one who is in transit toward the Father

moves.label: M51
moves.paraphrase: He commands her to go to those he calls his brothers.
moves.substrate: the group Jesus names 'my brothers' (as destination)
moves.outcome: Mary set on her way to them
moves.sitz: a risen one commissioning his witness

moves.label: M52
moves.paraphrase: He commands her to deliver a message to them.
moves.substrate: the further embedded announcement (M54) to be delivered to the brothers
moves.outcome: the announcement conveyed to the brothers
moves.sitz: a risen one entrusting a witness with a message

moves.label: M53
moves.paraphrase: He announces that he is going up to the one who is his and their Father, his and their God.
moves.outcome: arrival with the one named 'my Father and your Father, my God and your God'
moves.sitz: a risen one declaring his transition to the Father
moves.narrator: Jesus, within a doubly-embedded reported speech

moves.label: M54
moves.paraphrase: Mary Magdalene reaches the disciples.
moves.outcome: Mary present with the disciples
moves.sitz: a commissioned witness carrying out her sending

moves.label: M55
moves.paraphrase: She reports to them what happened at the tomb and what he told her.
moves.substrate: the two embedded reports to the disciples (M57 and M58)
moves.outcome: the disciples receive her testimony
moves.sitz: the first witness delivering resurrection-testimony to the circle

moves.label: M56
moves.paraphrase: She reports that she has seen the Lord.
moves.outcome: a completed sighting of the Lord
moves.sitz: a witness naming her firsthand encounter

moves.label: M57
moves.paraphrase: She reports that he had spoken these things to her.
moves.substrate: the words previously spoken to Mary (referring back to Jesus's speech in M49-M54)
moves.outcome: Mary was addressed with these words
moves.sitz: a witness relaying that words were spoken and their content

moves.label: M58
moves.paraphrase: That evening, on the first day of the week, the disciples were gathered behind bolted doors out of fear of the Judean authorities.
moves.substrate: the room where they were meeting
moves.outcome: the disciples enclosed together, hidden from outside view
moves.sitz: followers of an executed teacher hiding from local authorities on the evening of the first day of the week
moves.paradigm: fearful hiding of a persecuted group

moves.label: M59
moves.paraphrase: Jesus arrives where they are.
moves.substrate: the location of the assembled disciples
moves.outcome: Jesus present among them
moves.sitz: a risen one appearing to a hidden circle

moves.label: M60
moves.paraphrase: He takes a position among them.
moves.substrate: the middle of the assembled group
moves.outcome: Jesus stationed at the center of the group
moves.sitz: a risen one visibly placing himself among his followers

moves.label: M61
moves.paraphrase: He addresses them with a greeting.
moves.outcome: the disciples are greeted
moves.sitz: a risen one greeting his followers

moves.label: M62
moves.paraphrase: He wishes peace upon them.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: a customary greeting-blessing, freighted here by the speaker's identity

moves.label: M63
moves.paraphrase: He displays to them his hands and his side.
moves.outcome: the wounded parts of his body visible to the disciples
moves.sitz: a risen one making his crucified body identifiable

moves.label: M64
moves.paraphrase: The disciples recognize him as the Lord upon seeing him.
moves.outcome: visual recognition of the Lord
moves.sitz: followers identifying their risen teacher

moves.label: M65
moves.paraphrase: They become glad in response.
moves.outcome: a state of gladness in the disciples
moves.sitz: followers moving from fear to joy at recognition

moves.label: M66
moves.paraphrase: Jesus addresses them a second time with a greeting and a sending.
moves.outcome: the disciples receive his second address
moves.sitz: a risen one turning greeting into commissioning

moves.label: M67
moves.paraphrase: He again wishes peace upon them.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: a peace-greeting repeated to open a commissioning

moves.label: M68
moves.paraphrase: He sends them out, aligning his sending of them with the Father's sending of him.
moves.outcome: the disciples sent as he was sent by the Father
moves.sitz: a risen one extending his own commissioning to his followers

moves.label: M69
moves.paraphrase: He blows his breath onto them.
moves.outcome: the disciples receive his breath on them
moves.sitz: a symbolic breath-conferral echoing a life-giving act

moves.label: M70
moves.paraphrase: He speaks to them again, issuing a command and two conditional authorizations.
moves.substrate: the embedded imperative and conditional authorizations (M72, M73, M74)
moves.outcome: the disciples receive his instruction
moves.sitz: a risen one paired-conferring breath and authority

moves.label: M71
moves.paraphrase: He commands them to take the Holy Spirit into themselves.
moves.outcome: the Holy Spirit received by the disciples
moves.sitz: a risen one conferring the promised Spirit on his followers

moves.label: M72
moves.paraphrase: He tells them that when they release someone's sins, those sins stand released.
moves.outcome: those sins stand forgiven for those persons
moves.sitz: a risen one delegating a judicial-mercy authority

moves.label: M73
moves.paraphrase: He tells them that when they hold someone's sins in place, those sins stand held.
moves.outcome: those sins stand retained for those persons
moves.sitz: a risen one delegating the counterpart authority to withhold release

moves.label: M74
moves.paraphrase: Thomas, one of the twelve and nicknamed the Twin, was absent from the group during the appearance.
moves.agent: Thomas (one of the twelve, called the Twin)
moves.substrate: the rest of the disciples at the moment of Jesus's coming
moves.outcome: Thomas outside the circle of witnesses to this appearance
moves.sitz: a teller noting a member of the twelve was missing from a decisive event
moves.narrator: the evangelist, third-person, as retrospective aside setting up the next scene

moves.label: M75
moves.paraphrase: The other disciples report to Thomas that they have seen the Lord.
moves.substrate: the embedded testimony (M77) delivered to Thomas
moves.outcome: Thomas receives their testimony
moves.sitz: witnesses relaying a resurrection-appearance to the absent one

moves.label: M76
moves.paraphrase: They claim to have had a firsthand sighting of the Lord.
moves.outcome: a completed sighting of the Lord
moves.sitz: witnesses naming their firsthand encounter
moves.narrator: the other disciples, within their reported speech

moves.label: M77
moves.paraphrase: Thomas replies to them with the terms on which he will believe.
moves.outcome: the other disciples receive his terms
moves.sitz: a doubter setting verification-terms against a communal testimony

moves.label: M78
moves.paraphrase: He declares he will withhold belief until he can inspect the nail-marks by sight, probe them with his finger, and place his hand in the side-wound.
moves.substrate: the disciples' claim that they have seen the Lord
moves.outcome: a refusal to believe pending the specified conditions
moves.sitz: a demand for tactile-visual verification of the crucifixion-wounds on the risen body

moves.label: M79
moves.paraphrase: After a week, the disciples are again gathered indoors, and this time Thomas is present.
moves.substrate: the indoor space where they meet
moves.outcome: the disciples, including Thomas, gathered inside
moves.sitz: a second gathering of the circle eight days later

moves.label: M80
moves.paraphrase: Jesus arrives among them despite the shut doors.
moves.substrate: the location of the assembled disciples
moves.outcome: Jesus present among them
moves.sitz: a risen one appearing again inside a shut room

moves.label: M81
moves.paraphrase: He takes his place at the center of the group.
moves.substrate: the middle of the assembled group
moves.outcome: Jesus stationed at the center
moves.sitz: a risen one visibly placing himself among his followers

moves.label: M82
moves.paraphrase: He greets them.
moves.outcome: the disciples are greeted
moves.sitz: a risen one repeating the peace-greeting

moves.label: M83
moves.paraphrase: He wishes peace upon them.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: a peace-greeting inside the second appearance

moves.label: M84
moves.paraphrase: He then turns and speaks directly to Thomas.
moves.substrate: the embedded directives to Thomas (M86, M87, M88, M89, M90)
moves.outcome: Thomas is addressed with a series of instructions
moves.sitz: a risen one meeting a doubter on the doubter's stated terms

moves.label: M85
moves.paraphrase: He tells Thomas to extend his finger toward him.
moves.outcome: Thomas's finger extended toward Jesus
moves.sitz: an invitation to tactile inspection matching the doubter's terms

moves.label: M86
moves.paraphrase: He tells Thomas to look at his hands.
moves.outcome: Thomas's visual inspection of Jesus's hands
moves.sitz: an invitation to visual inspection of the wounds

moves.label: M87
moves.paraphrase: He tells Thomas to extend his hand toward him.
moves.outcome: Thomas's hand extended toward Jesus
moves.sitz: a further tactile invitation

moves.label: M88
moves.paraphrase: He tells Thomas to place that hand into the wound in his side.
moves.substrate: Thomas's hand, placed into Jesus's side
moves.outcome: Thomas's hand inside the side-wound
moves.sitz: the deepest tactile verification, matching Thomas's stated terms

moves.label: M89
moves.paraphrase: He commands him to shift from disbelief into belief.
moves.outcome: a state of belief in Thomas
moves.sitz: a summons to complete the movement the verification enables

moves.label: M90
moves.paraphrase: Thomas responds by addressing him.
moves.outcome: Jesus is addressed with Thomas's response
moves.sitz: a doubter answering with a confession

moves.label: M91
moves.paraphrase: He names Jesus as his Lord and his God.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: a follower's acclamatory confession of the risen one

moves.label: M92
moves.paraphrase: Jesus replies to him with an evaluation and a beatitude.
moves.outcome: Thomas receives his reply
moves.sitz: the risen one commenting on the belief-through-seeing pattern

moves.label: M93
moves.paraphrase: He evaluates that Thomas has come to belief on the ground of having seen him.
moves.outcome: Thomas now in a state of belief, grounded in having seen
moves.sitz: an evaluation of belief-via-sight

moves.label: M94
moves.paraphrase: He pronounces a blessing on those who come to belief without seeing.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: a benediction on the not-yet-eyewitness generation of believers

moves.label: M95
moves.paraphrase: The narrator asserts that Jesus performed many further signs in the presence of his followers beyond the ones he has recorded.
moves.substrate: further sign-events performed before the disciples
moves.outcome: a body of witnessed signs beyond those in this account
moves.sitz: a teller concluding a written account by pointing beyond what he included
moves.narrator: the evangelist, third-person, as book-summary aside

moves.label: M96
moves.paraphrase: He notes that those further signs are absent from the present writing.
moves.outcome: a written record that excludes them
moves.sitz: a teller marking the limits of his own written selection
moves.narrator: the evangelist, third-person, as book-summary aside

moves.label: M97
moves.paraphrase: He notes that what he has written was written for a specific purpose regarding the reader.
moves.agent: these things (the accounts he has selected)
moves.outcome: a written record aimed at the reader's believing (M99) and living (M101)
moves.sitz: a teller declaring the purpose of his written selection
moves.narrator: the evangelist, third-person, as book-purpose statement

moves.label: M98
moves.paraphrase: The intended purpose is that the reader come to believe a specific claim about Jesus.
moves.outcome: the reader in a state of belief in that claim
moves.sitz: a teller naming reader-belief as the intended effect of his book

moves.label: M99
moves.paraphrase: The claim to be believed identifies Jesus as the Christ and as the Son of God.
moves.outcome: not-stated
moves.sitz: a first-century identity-claim binding two titles onto Jesus

moves.label: M100
moves.paraphrase: The further intended purpose is that, through such believing, the reader may have life in his name.
moves.substrate: the reader's condition apart from life-in-his-name
moves.outcome: life possessed by the reader, held in the name of Jesus
moves.sitz: a teller naming reader-life as the further intended effect of belief
